payload.title: Self-correlation candidate
payload.statement: Horizontal pre-boundary GR self-correlation can provide a useful structural candidate independent of typewell matching for selected regimes.
payload.evidence_for: Host material and competition discussions describe repeated horizontal-log motifs; E006 proves that a weaker GR-derived leg can add stable value when placed through strict nested validation.
payload.evidence_against: Repeated motifs, toe missingness, changing stratigraphy, and long horizons may make self-correlation ambiguous or redundant with E006 PF evidence.
payload.next_test: E007: pre-register a legal prefix-template/self-correlation path with deterministic template-shuffle, no-GR fallback, repeated-fold, tail, spatial/typewell stress, runtime, and residual-correlation controls against E006.
